comment: Deployment config for Cloudflare Pages (pnpm deploy:check). The origins assume the Pages project names chartstays (app) and chartstays-<area> (nodes); a project named X is served at https://X.pages.dev, so if a name is taken, change it here (app and every node origin) and use the same names in wrangler pages deploy. https only: localhost, http and demo/test nodes fail the build.
